string_literals: A FluentTheme widget is necessary to draw this layout.
The elevation can NOT be negative
The opacity can NOT be negative
The routeInformationParser and routerDelegate cannot be null.
To have a subtitle, there must be a title
To introduce a FluentTheme widget, you can either directly include one, or use a widget that contains FluentTheme itself, such as FluentApp
Use keyboardType TextInputType.multiline when using TextInputAction.newline on a multiline TextField.
You can NOT open it twice
You can NOT provide both child and builder
You can NOT provide both opacity and elevation
You can only create a tabview in a RenderBox with defined width
minLines and maxLines must be null when expands is true.
minLines can't be greater than maxLines
